title: Shipping & Handling Policy
summary: Orders ship from our US warehouse within 1–2 business days. Orders placed before 12:00 PM ET on a business day usually ship the same day. Free standard shipping on US orders over $35.00; flat $4.95 otherwise.

rules.title: Processing time
rules.detail: We pick, pack, and hand off orders to the carrier within 1–2 business days (Monday–Friday, excluding US federal holidays).

rules.title: Same-day cut-off
rules.detail: Orders placed before 12:00 PM ET on a business day are eligible for same-day dispatch when stock is available.

rules.title: Carriers & services
rules.detail: We ship via USPS Ground Advantage, UPS Ground, and FedEx Home Delivery. The carrier is chosen automatically based on package weight and destination.

rules.title: Shipping rates
rules.detail: Standard shipping is free on US orders over $35.00; otherwise a flat $4.95 applies. Expedited options are quoted at checkout.

rules.title: Tracking
rules.detail: A tracking number is uploaded to the marketplace within 24 hours of dispatch and is also included in the shipment confirmation email.

rules.title: Domestic only
rules.detail: We currently ship within the 50 US states. We do not ship internationally or to freight forwarders.

exceptions: Alaska, Hawaii, and Puerto Rico may take 2–4 extra business days and may carry a carrier surcharge.
PO boxes are serviced by USPS only; UPS/FedEx services cannot deliver to PO boxes.
Oversized or heavy items (over 20 lb) may ship in multiple boxes and take 1 extra business day.
responseTemplate: Thanks for your patience, {{customer_name}}. Your order {{order_id}} is handled within 1–2 business days, and the tracking number is posted within 24 hours of dispatch. You'll receive the tracking link in your shipment confirmation.

title: Delivery Time Estimates
summary: Estimated delivery after dispatch: Standard 3–5 business days, Economy 5–8, Expedited 2–3. Peak season (late Nov–early Jan) and severe weather can add 2–3 days. Estimates are not guarantees.

rules.title: Standard service
rules.detail: 3–5 business days after dispatch, excluding Sundays and federal holidays.

rules.title: Economy service
rules.detail: 5–8 business days; used for some oversized items and remote ZIP codes.

rules.title: Expedited service
rules.detail: 2–3 business days when selected at checkout; available to most US ZIP codes.

rules.title: Estimates vs guarantees
rules.detail: Marketplace delivery dates are estimates, not guarantees. Carrier delays are outside our direct control.

rules.title: Peak season
rules.detail: During Black Friday through early January, add 2–3 business days to every estimate.

rules.title: Weather & disruptions
rules.detail: Severe weather, wildfires, and carrier network disruptions can delay delivery; we monitor affected ZIP codes and proactively update buyers.

exceptions: The 'delivered by' date shown on the marketplace is calculated by the marketplace, not by us.
Orders shipping to AK/HI/PR follow economy timelines.
responseTemplate: Great question, {{customer_name}} — your order {{order_id}} is on the {{service_level}} service, so it should arrive within {{estimate}} after dispatch. Weather or peak-season volume can add 2–3 days; I'll keep an eye on it for you.

title: Order Not Received / Tracking Stalled
summary: If tracking hasn't updated or the package is past its estimate: allow a 4-business-day grace window, then open a carrier trace. If the carrier can't locate it within 10 business days, the buyer chooses a free reship or full refund.

rules.title: First check
rules.detail: Confirm the shipping address on the order and ask the buyer to check with household members, front desk/leasing office, and around the delivery location.

rules.title: Grace window
rules.detail: Domestic orders are considered potentially delayed — not lost — until 4 business days after the estimated delivery date.

rules.title: Carrier trace
rules.detail: After the grace window, we open a Missing Mail search or trace with the carrier; carriers take 24–48 hours to respond.

rules.title: Resolution
rules.detail: If the carrier cannot locate the package within 10 business days of the trace, we reship the item or issue a full refund — the buyer's choice.

rules.title: Communication
rules.detail: Buyers are given a case reference and a follow-up date so they are never left waiting silently.

exceptions: 'Delivered' scans that the buyer disputes are handled under the lost-package policy with a carrier delivery verification.
High-value orders over $250 require a signature; unsigned deliveries are investigated before refunding.
responseTemplate: I'm sorry your package is taking longer than expected, {{customer_name}}. I checked {{order_id}} and opened a carrier trace (ref {{case_ref}}). Carriers typically respond within 24–48 hours. If there's no movement by {{follow_up_date}}, we'll reship it or refund you in full — whichever you prefer.

title: Lost / Undelivered Package Resolution
summary: A package is lost when tracking shows no movement for 7+ consecutive days or the carrier confirms it can't be located. Resolution: free replacement or full refund, once per order. 'Delivered but not found' cases require carrier delivery verification first.

rules.title: Definition of lost
rules.detail: A package is considered lost when (a) tracking has shown no movement for 7+ consecutive days, or (b) the carrier confirms it cannot be located after a trace.

rules.title: Delivered-not-found
rules.detail: If tracking shows 'Delivered' but the buyer cannot find it, we file a delivery verification with the carrier; many packages are found at a neighbor, porch, or mail room within 24–72 hours.

rules.title: Resolution options
rules.detail: Once confirmed lost, the buyer chooses a free replacement (subject to stock) or a 100% refund to the original payment method.

rules.title: One-time resolution
rules.detail: A shipment marked lost is resolved once per order; reopened claims on the same order require human review.

rules.title: High-value orders
rules.detail: Orders over $250 with a verified delivery scan may require a signed affidavit or a police report for marketplace claim purposes before resolution.

exceptions: Buyer-provided incorrect addresses are not covered; see the address-change policy.
Repeat lost-package claims from the same buyer (2+) are flagged for human review.
responseTemplate: Thanks for your patience, {{customer_name}}. Since the carrier hasn't located {{order_id}}, I can offer you a free replacement or a full refund — just let me know which you'd prefer, and either way you'll see it resolved within 2 business days.

title: Damaged Item on Arrival
summary: Report damage within 48 hours of delivery with photos (video for electronics). Items under $20 don't need to be returned. Replacement is offered first; refund if out of stock. Carrier inspection may be requested for high-value claims.

rules.title: Report window
rules.detail: Damage must be reported within 48 hours of delivery with photos (and video for electronics) showing the damage, packaging, and shipping label.

rules.title: Keep the packaging
rules.detail: Buyers should keep the box and packing material until the claim is resolved; carriers may require an inspection.

rules.title: Under $20
rules.detail: For items under $20, no return is required — we issue a replacement or refund immediately after photo review.

rules.title: Replacement first
rules.detail: Our default resolution is a free replacement of the same item. If it's out of stock, the buyer chooses a full refund or a similar alternative.

rules.title: High-value damage
rules.detail: For damage claims over $100, we may request a carrier inspection; the buyer keeps all packaging until the inspection is complete.

exceptions: Damage reported after 48 hours is reviewed case-by-case and may follow standard return rules.
Fragile items still follow this policy — the buyer is never asked to pay return shipping for damage in transit.
responseTemplate: I'm really sorry it arrived damaged, {{customer_name}}. Could you send 2–3 photos — the item, the packaging, and the shipping label? Once I have those, I'll ship a replacement right away (or refund you fully if you prefer, or if stock has run out).

title: Defective, Wrong, or Not-as-Described Item
summary: Report within 7 days of delivery with photos/video. Verified defects, wrong items, or listings that don't match get a prepaid return label, no restocking fee, and the buyer's choice of replacement or full refund.

rules.title: Report window
rules.detail: Defects, wrong items, or items significantly not as described must be reported within 7 days of delivery.

rules.title: Evidence
rules.detail: Clear photos/video of the item, plus a photo of the SKU/model label, are required so we can verify the pick/pack error.

rules.title: Our cost
rules.detail: If the item is verified defective, wrong, or not as described, we provide a prepaid return label (or waive the return entirely for low-value items) — no restocking fee in any case.

rules.title: Resolution
rules.detail: The buyer chooses a replacement (same item) or a 100% refund. We cover return shipping either way.

rules.title: Return condition
rules.detail: Items should be returned with all included accessories and original packaging where possible; missing accessories may result in a partial deduction only for non-defect claims.

exceptions: Buyer's remorse (ordered the wrong size/color by mistake) follows the general returns policy where the buyer pays return shipping.
Electronics with signs of physical abuse, liquid damage, or tampering are handled under the warranty policy.
responseTemplate: I'm sorry about that, {{customer_name}} — that's not how it should have arrived. Please send a quick photo/video of the issue and I'll get a prepaid return label to you right away. You can choose a free replacement or a full refund, and there's never a restocking fee for our mistakes.

title: Missing Parts or Accessories
summary: Report within 7 days. If the part is in stock we ship it free within 2 business days. If unavailable, the buyer chooses a partial refund (15–30%) or a full refund with prepaid return label.

rules.title: Report window
rules.detail: Missing parts or accessories must be reported within 7 days of delivery.

rules.title: First resolution
rules.detail: If the missing part is in stock, we ship it free (expedited) within 2 business days.

rules.title: If unavailable
rules.detail: If the part cannot be sourced, the buyer chooses a partial refund (15–30% of item price depending on the part's importance) or a full refund with a prepaid return label.

rules.title: Assembly items
rules.detail: For furniture and multi-part items, we verify the packing list and offer video assembly assistance before treating parts as missing.

exceptions: Consumables (batteries, clips, stickers) are reshipped free once per order.
Missing parts on customized items follow the same rules — customization never forfeits this coverage.
responseTemplate: So sorry about the missing part, {{customer_name}}. I'll ship the replacement part free of charge — it will leave our warehouse within 2 business days with tracking. If you'd rather have a partial refund instead, just say the word.

title: 30-Day Return Policy (General Merchandise)
summary: Unused items in original packaging can be returned within 30 calendar days of delivery. Buyer pays return shipping for remorse returns; we pay when the item is defective, wrong, or damaged.

rules.title: Window
rules.detail: Returns are accepted within 30 calendar days of the delivery date.

rules.title: Condition
rules.detail: Items must be unused, undamaged, and in the original packaging with all accessories, manuals, and tags included.

rules.title: Proof of purchase
rules.detail: The marketplace order number is sufficient; no separate receipt is needed.

rules.title: Return shipping (remorse)
rules.detail: When the buyer changed their mind or ordered the wrong item, the buyer covers return shipping at the marketplace's prevailing label rate.

rules.title: Return shipping (our fault)
rules.detail: When the item is defective, damaged, or not as described, we provide a prepaid label — the buyer never pays.

rules.title: Refund timing
rules.detail: Refunds are issued after the returned item is received and inspected; see the refund-timelines policy.

rules.title: Restocking fee
rules.detail: There is no restocking fee for standard returns in acceptable condition.

exceptions: Personalized/customized items, hygiene products with broken seals, final-sale items, and gift cards are not returnable.
Returns sent without prior authorization or after 30 days may be refused or partially refunded.
Electronics must include all original accessories and packaging to be eligible.
responseTemplate: Happy to help you start a return, {{customer_name}}. You're within our 30-day window — once I confirm the item is unused and complete, I'll issue return instructions. If the return is due to a defect or our mistake, the return shipping is on us.

title: Who Pays Return Shipping?
summary: We pay for defects, wrong items, and damage (prepaid label, no exceptions). Buyers pay for remorse returns (changed mind / ordered wrong variant). Low-value verified defects skip the return entirely.

rules.title: Our error, our cost
rules.detail: Defective, damaged, wrong, or not-as-described items: prepaid return label at our cost, no exceptions.

rules.title: Remorse returns
rules.detail: Changed-mind, wrong-size, or wrong-color ordered by the buyer: the buyer pays return shipping at the marketplace label rate.

rules.title: Exchanges
rules.detail: Size/color exchanges for remorse reasons are handled as a return + reorder; if we made the error, both legs are free.

rules.title: Low-value waivers
rules.detail: For verified defect claims under $20, we often skip the return entirely and ship a replacement — it's faster and cheaper for everyone.

rules.title: Carrier rates
rules.detail: Buyers can also use their own label; we recommend a tracked service, as untracked returns that go missing cannot be refunded.

exceptions: Return labels are non-transferable and expire after 14 days.
International returns are not supported; US-only shipping applies.
responseTemplate: To make this easy: since the issue was on our side, I'm sending you a prepaid return label — you won't pay a cent. Once it's on the way, your replacement or refund is processed as soon as the first carrier scan appears.

title: Refund Timelines & Methods
summary: Returns are inspected within 1 business day of arrival and refunds issued within 1 business day after that (2–3 days for $250+ orders). Banks take 3–5 business days to post. Refunds always return to the original payment method via the marketplace.

rules.title: Inspection
rules.detail: Returned items are inspected within 1 business day of arrival at our warehouse.

rules.title: Issuance
rules.detail: Refunds are issued within 1 business day of a successful inspection; high-value orders ($250+) may take 2–3 business days for second review.

rules.title: Bank posting
rules.detail: After we issue the refund, banks/card issuers take 3–5 business days (up to 10 for some debit cards) to display it.

rules.title: Method
rules.detail: Refunds are always returned to the original payment source through the marketplace; we cannot send refunds by cash, check, or to a different card.

rules.title: Partial refunds
rules.detail: Partial refunds (e.g., keep-item discounts or missing-part compensations) are issued immediately without a return.

exceptions: eBay refunds are issued through the eBay resolution center so they appear against the original transaction.
Gift-card portions of payment are refunded to the marketplace balance per marketplace rules.
responseTemplate: As soon as your return is inspected (within 1 business day of arrival), I'll issue the refund — it then typically takes 3–5 business days to appear on your statement, depending on your bank. You'll get a confirmation message from us the moment it's processed.

title: Exchanges (Size, Color, Version)
summary: Exchanges run as return + reorder with stock held 48 hours. Free both ways when we made the error; buyer pays the return leg for remorse exchanges. Price differences are charged or refunded.

rules.title: How it works
rules.detail: Exchanges are processed as a return plus a new order once the return scan is visible, so buyers aren't charged twice and stock is held for 48 hours.

rules.title: Our error
rules.detail: Wrong size/color/version we shipped: the exchange is completely free, including both shipping legs.

rules.title: Buyer's choice
rules.detail: Bought the wrong variant: the return leg is at the buyer's cost; the replacement ships with standard shipping.

rules.title: Price differences
rules.detail: If the new variant costs more, the difference is payable; if less, the difference is refunded.

rules.title: Timing
rules.detail: Exchange requests follow the same 30-day window as returns.

exceptions: Out-of-stock variants convert to a refund or a similar alternative.
Limited-edition or clearance variants may not be exchangeable.
responseTemplate: No problem at all, {{customer_name}} — I'll set up the exchange. Once your original item shows its first carrier scan, I'll ship the new {{variant}} right away. Since this was our mix-up, both shipping legs are on us.

title: Order Cancellation
summary: Free cancellation before dispatch — while the order is 'Processing' with no tracking number yet. After dispatch, cancellation isn't possible; the buyer may refuse delivery or use the return flow.

rules.title: Before dispatch
rules.detail: Cancellations are free and instant while the order status is 'Processing' and no tracking number exists.

rules.title: After dispatch
rules.detail: Once a tracking number is generated, we cannot cancel; the buyer may refuse delivery (returned to sender) or use the standard return flow.

rules.title: Refusal
rules.detail: A refused package is refunded once it arrives back at our warehouse, minus actual shipping costs if the order had free shipping and was a remorse refusal.

rules.title: Partial cancellation
rules.detail: On multi-item orders, we can cancel any line that hasn't dispatched; the rest ships as normal.

rules.title: Refund speed
rules.detail: Cancelled orders are refunded immediately to the original payment method (see refund-timelines for bank posting).

exceptions: Custom/personalized items cannot be cancelled once production starts (usually 12 hours after order).
Bundle promotions: cancelling part of a bundle may void the bundle price on the remaining items.
responseTemplate: Good news, {{customer_name}} — your order {{order_id}} hasn't shipped yet, so I've cancelled it as requested. The refund is on its way now and typically appears within 3–5 business days. Anything else I can help with?

title: Shipping Address Changes
summary: Free before dispatch (any time before a tracking number exists). After dispatch: carrier intercept/re-route at the buyer's cost (~$17–$20), not guaranteed. Undeliverable due to a buyer-typed wrong address → refund minus actual shipping and carrier fees.

rules.title: Before dispatch
rules.detail: Address changes are free any time before a tracking number is generated.

rules.title: After dispatch
rules.detail: We can request a carrier intercept (USPS Package Intercept / UPS Delivery Intercept, ~$17–$20) at the buyer's cost; success is not guaranteed once the package is in motion.

rules.title: Wrong/incomplete address
rules.detail: If a package returns as undeliverable due to an address the buyer provided incorrectly, we refund the item price minus actual shipping costs and any carrier fees.

rules.title: Apartment/suite numbers
rules.detail: Missing unit numbers are a common cause of 'delivered not received' — we verify these first before opening a carrier trace.

rules.title: State/large changes
rules.detail: Changing city or state after dispatch is not possible; we refund once the package returns to sender, and the buyer reorders.

exceptions: Address changes are not possible on orders already marked 'Out for delivery'.
Freight-forwarder addresses are not supported.
responseTemplate: I've updated your shipping address — you're all set, {{customer_name}}. The change is free and the order will go to the corrected address. You'll get a confirmation as soon as the label is created.

title: Price Drop & Price Match Policy
summary: One-time courtesy adjustment if our own listing price drops within 7 calendar days of purchase. Excludes coupons, flash sales, clearance, bundles, and other sellers' prices.

rules.title: Window
rules.detail: If the price of the exact same item from our store drops within 7 calendar days of purchase, we honor the lower price once.

rules.title: Same item only
rules.detail: The adjustment applies to the identical SKU/variant, not to similar or newer models.

rules.title: How to claim
rules.detail: The buyer contacts us with the order number; we verify the current price and issue a refund for the difference.

rules.title: One per order
rules.detail: Price adjustments are one-time per order and cannot be combined with other goodwill credits.

rules.title: Payment
rules.detail: The difference is refunded to the original payment method through the marketplace.

exceptions: Coupon codes, sitewide sales, flash sales, lightning deals, and clearance prices are excluded.
Prices from other sellers, other marketplaces, or previous listings are not matched.
Custom and bulk/wholesale orders are excluded.
responseTemplate: Thanks for flagging that, {{customer_name}} — I checked and the price did drop within our 7-day window, so I've issued a refund for the difference of ${{amount}}. It should appear on your statement within a few business days.

title: Payments, Taxes & Invoices
summary: All payments run through marketplace checkout (eBay/TikTok Shop/Temu) — we never request payment outside it. Sales tax is collected by the marketplace. Receipts are on the order page; business invoices available on request.

rules.title: Payments
rules.detail: All payments are processed by the marketplace's checkout (eBay managed payments, TikTok Shop, Temu).

rules.title: Never off-platform
rules.detail: We never ask buyers to pay via bank transfer, gift cards, or cash apps. Such requests are scams — report them and contact us directly.

rules.title: Sales tax
rules.detail: Sales tax is calculated and collected by the marketplace according to destination-state law; we do not control tax rates.

rules.title: Invoices/receipts
rules.detail: A payment receipt is available on the marketplace order page. Business invoices are available on request within 1 business day.

rules.title: Payment issues
rules.detail: Failed payments, expired cards, or payment holds are managed by marketplace support; we cannot see or change card details.

exceptions: Bulk/wholesale orders (50+ units) may be quoted separately with agreed terms.
Orders where payment is later reversed by the buyer's bank follow the marketplace dispute process.
responseTemplate: All payments go securely through the marketplace checkout, {{customer_name}} — we never ask for payment outside it. For a business invoice, just reply with your company name and tax ID and I'll send one within 1 business day.

title: Limited Warranty (Electronics & Durables)
summary: 12-month limited warranty against manufacturing defects from the delivery date on electronics and durables. Verified claims get a free replacement (or full refund if out of stock). Excludes wear, misuse, and liquid damage.

rules.title: Coverage
rules.detail: Electronics and durable goods carry a 12-month limited warranty against defects in materials and workmanship, starting from the delivery date.

rules.title: How to claim
rules.detail: Contact us with the order number, a description of the fault, and a short video demonstrating the issue.

rules.title: Resolution
rules.detail: Verified warranty claims are resolved with a free replacement when available, or a full refund if the item is out of stock.

rules.title: Shipping
rules.detail: Warranty replacements ship free within the US; return of the defective unit is required for items over $50 (prepaid label provided).

rules.title: Timeline
rules.detail: Claims are reviewed within 1 business day; replacements ship within 2 business days of approval.

exceptions: Excluded: accidental damage, liquid damage, unauthorized repair, normal wear, and cosmetic wear. Battery capacity fade is covered only if under 80% within 6 months.
Consumables (batteries, bulbs, filters) carry a 90-day warranty.
Warranty is tied to the original order and is non-transferable to a third-party resale buyer.
responseTemplate: Thank you for the details, {{customer_name}}. Based on the video, this looks like a manufacturing defect, so it's covered under our 12-month warranty. I'll ship a free replacement within 2 business days — no return shipping cost to you.

title: Custom & Personalized Items
summary: Made-to-order items: free cancellation within 12 hours; production takes 2–4 business days; non-returnable once produced unless defective, damaged, or different from the approved proof.

rules.title: Cancellation window
rules.detail: Custom orders can be cancelled free within 12 hours of purchase, before production starts.

rules.title: Production
rules.detail: Production begins after 12 hours (or after design proof approval if requested) and takes 2–4 business days.

rules.title: Returns
rules.detail: Customized items are non-returnable and non-refundable once produced, unless they arrive defective, damaged, or different from the approved design.

rules.title: Proofing
rules.detail: For text/logo customization, we send a digital proof for approval; production starts only after the buyer confirms.

rules.title: Our error
rules.detail: If the final product differs from the approved proof, we remake it free or issue a full refund.

exceptions: Spelling/date errors in buyer-approved proofs are the buyer's responsibility.
Custom items cannot be exchanged for a different design or size.
responseTemplate: Since this is a personalized item, I can still cancel it free of charge within 12 hours of the order — after that it goes into production. If any detail differs from your approved proof, we'll remake it free.

title: Feedback & Review Communication
summary: We never incentivize or demand positive reviews. At most one polite review request ~3 days after delivery. Negative feedback: apologize publicly within 24h, resolve first, then may politely invite an update — never pressure.

rules.title: No review gating
rules.detail: We never offer discounts, refunds, or freebies in exchange for positive reviews — it violates marketplace policies.

rules.title: Request cadence
rules.detail: At most one review request per order, sent about 3 days after confirmed delivery; buyers who leave no review are not re-asked.

rules.title: Negative feedback handling
rules.detail: Reply publicly within 24 hours with a calm, solution-focused tone. Never argue, never blame the buyer, never post personal data.

rules.title: After resolution
rules.detail: Once an issue is resolved, we may politely invite the buyer to update their feedback, but we never ask for '5 stars' or offer anything in return.

rules.title: Contact preference
rules.detail: If a buyer asks us not to contact them again, we comply immediately and mark the conversation closed.

exceptions: Suspected extortion ('refund me or I'll leave 1 star') is escalated to a human supervisor immediately.
Feedback containing threats, profanity, or personal data is reported through marketplace channels.
responseTemplate: Thank you for the honest feedback, {{customer_name}}. I'm sorry we fell short — here's what I can do to make it right: {{resolution}}. I'd love the chance to fix this for you, and if you feel we've earned it afterward, we'd appreciate an updated review — but either way, thank you for the opportunity.

title: Fraud & Abuse Handling
summary: The AI never accuses a customer of fraud. Suspected abuse is escalated quietly to a human within 1 business day with evidence attached. Red flags: address mismatch, empty-box returns, 3+ returns/claims in 90 days, refund-then-chargeback.

rules.title: Tone
rules.detail: The AI never accuses a customer of fraud; suspected abuse is escalated quietly to a human supervisor with evidence attached.

rules.title: Red flags
rules.detail: Address buyer/ship-to mismatch, 3+ 'delivered not received' claims, empty/used-item returns, immediate chargeback after a refund, and pressure for off-platform refunds.

rules.title: Evidence
rules.detail: Attach order history, carrier scans (with GPS delivery details when available), return photos, and chat excerpts to the escalation.

rules.title: Response to customer
rules.detail: Continue the polite standard resolution flow for small amounts; hold high-value suspicious claims pending human review within 1 business day.

rules.title: Marketplace reporting
rules.detail: Confirmed abuse is reported via the marketplace's buyer-abuse channels and added to our internal watchlist.

exceptions: First-time small-claim buyers are given the benefit of the doubt.
Law-enforcement requests are routed to a human supervisor and require proper legal process.
responseTemplate: Thank you for reaching out, {{customer_name}}. I've recorded your claim and it's under review with our team — you'll hear back within 1 business day. We appreciate your patience while we complete the review.

title: Marketplace Case / Claim Handling
summary: Marketplace cases (eBay 'Item not received'/'Not as described', TikTok Shop after-sales, Temu disputes) are answered within 24h with tracking and evidence, never left to auto-resolve. Claims over $150, legal threats, or multi-case buyers go to a human within 1 business day.

rules.title: Response SLA
rules.detail: Any marketplace case is answered within 24 hours; buyer-initiated messages get a first response within 2 hours during business hours.

rules.title: Evidence
rules.detail: Provide tracking with delivery confirmation, photos of the shipped item, packing records, and prior chat history.

rules.title: No auto-resolve
rules.detail: Cases are never left to expire; when a resolution is agreed, we ask the buyer to close the case on their side while we process the refund/replacement.

rules.title: Escalation
rules.detail: Claims above $150, legal threats, or multi-case buyers are escalated to a human within 1 business day.

rules.title: Marketplace rules first
rules.detail: Marketplace policy (eBay Money Back Guarantee, Temu Buyer Protection, TikTok Shop after-sales rules) overrides internal policy where they conflict.

exceptions: If the marketplace has already ruled against us, we comply and process within the required deadline.
Chargebacks follow the payment processor timeline and are handled by human review.
responseTemplate: I understand, {{customer_name}}, and I'd like to resolve this right away. I've attached the delivery tracking and shipping photos to your case. If you're happy with the resolution, you can close the case on your end and I'll make sure your refund/replacement is processed immediately.
